note: Plastic-generation part compatibility from a published community sheet. Compatibility is finer-grained than generation and is measured physical fit — it is not inferable from any field we hold, and guessing it would produce a build suggestion that breaks someone's property. Three of the sheet's six tabs are the SAME 145 rows sorted differently (verified by order-independent key), so only the three distinct shapes are read. A verdict is structured only where the prose states one; no compatibility SCORE is invented from the notes.
partNotes: Specific Part Notes: Customize Gear (Free Shaft Ver.) Shaft: CEW must always be attached after SG is placed in base for non EG Bases.
Customise Grip Base: Tip must be removed to use other shafts.
Magne Flat Base: Tip must be removed to use other shafts.
SG Grip Base: Tip must be removed to use other shafts.
SG Grip Change Base: Tip must be removed to use other shafts.
Neo SG  (Double Bearing Ver.) and Customize Gear (Free Shaft Ver.): NSK Bearing in top position is sometimes a tight fit. Make sure it is centred
NSK bearings were used in any positions where space is tight. That said
Other Broad Compatibility notes: The Attack Rings of Four Layer System Beyblades (from release #1 Ultimate Dragoon to #33 Sparkling Attacker) cannot be used on left spin gears.

Any Base setup not listed here shouldn't fit/be legal, but if you find something which fits and isn't listed, or have any other errors to point out, post in the thread here after you've read the first post:  http://worldbeyblade.org/Thread-Plastic-SG-Base-Tip-Etc-Compatibility-Doc
